dedupe_keys.name: federated edge semantic learning for decentralized resilient evacuation fesl dre simulation dataset

description: Ahmad Abadleh publishes a synthetic indoor-evacuation dataset generated to assess decentralised routing under dynamic hazards and partial network failure. Zenodo serves six CSV and text files under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The short README defines agent states, behavioural categories, graph nodes and edges, hazards, density, exits and simulation settings. Occupants move through a grid graph while hazard levels change with distance from specified sources. These tables can benchmark route-choice and coordination methods in building evacuation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this FESL-DRE test case. A limitation is that calm, panic, familiar and confused profiles are synthetically assigned, not measured behavioural responses. The README claims generation code exists but gives no direct code link, so exact reproduction was not verified. The CSVs were not downloaded, and agent or hazard values were not checked.
